snippet.title: Emery Hearts - Gameplay Reveal Trailer
snippet.description:
Discover Emery Hearts, an action JRPG with a retro soul and modern mechanics.
Explore a vibrant pixel art world, face enemies in real-time combat, solve puzzles, jump across platforms, and master new abilities as your journey unfolds.

Inspired by the classic JRPGs of the 90s, Emery Hearts aims to recapture that direct, dynamic, and magical feeling that defined a generation.

💫 Story, exploration, platforming, and a unique connection with the planet that changes everything.

🧭 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2732480/Emery_Hearts
💬 Join the community on Discord: https://discord.gg/pjs72J22ZR
